strategyThesis: Establish a shared, consented guest-data foundation by end-2027, enabling two high-value journey pilots to prove cross-property value, while deferring property-level app rebuilds and additional platform initiatives until evidence gates are met.

decision.text: Decide by end of October whether the 2027 priority is a single customer-data platform or property-by-property digital experience upgrades.

strategicAlternatives.name: Option A: Central Data Foundation First
strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Establish a single source of truth for guest data, enabling consistent reporting and cross-property analytics.

tradeoffs.text: Speed: slower to deliver value as foundation build takes time; risk of losing momentum.

tradeoffs.text: Control: high control over data standards and governance, but may face resistance from properties.

strategicAlternatives.name: Option B: Two Journey Pilots on Thin Shared Layer

strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Demonstrate value quickly with minimal infrastructure, learning what works before scaling.

tradeoffs.text: Scale: limited to two pilots, may not address broader fragmentation.
tradeoffs.label: ai_inference

tradeoffs.text: Learning: high learning value, but risk of pilots not being representative.
tradeoffs.label: ai_inference

strategicAlternatives.name: Option C: Common Standards with Property Autonomy
strategicAlternatives.whereToPlay: All properties with defined data standards
strategicAlternatives.howToWin: Enable local innovation while ensuring interoperability through common standards.
